correctness.rationale: TARGET headline verified line-by-line. Model fixed: X unit-tetrahedron surface, o=V0, F=conv(V1,V2,V3), c centroid, H=sqrt(2/3), L0=2*sqrt(3)/3, L0^2=4/3. Lemma A (d_X>=chord, equality in common face) holds because surface paths are R^3 curves and faces are convex flat triangles. Lemma B (first-entry split at t*=inf{t:gamma(t) in interior(F)}, r in dF, length>=d_X(o,r)+d_X(r,c)>=|o-r|+|r-c|) holds; interior(F) is relatively open in X so r cannot be interior else entry earlier. Lemma C edge profile h(u)=sqrt(3/4+u^2)+sqrt(1/12+u^2) even strictly increasing in |u|, minimum h(0)=sqrt(3)/2+sqrt(3)/6=L0, so d_X(o,c)>=L0 globally. Upper bound: three two-face unfoldings [S_k,F] develop to O=(0,sqrt3/2), c_F=(0,-sqrt3/6), straight vertical segment length L0 crossing edge midpoint at fraction 3/4; folding gives curves gamma_k straight in each face, orthogonal (pi/2+pi/2) meeting at edge so unfolded straight => genuine geodesics; length equals lower bound so minimizing and d_X(o,c)=L0 exactly. Distinctness via three distinct edge-midpoint crossings. Midpoints: L0/2 at 2/3 altitude => side-face centroids q_k, chords exactly 1/3 (q1-q2=(V1-V3)/3), so d_X(m_k,m_l)>=1/3 by Lemma A; rhombus unfolding gives <=sqrt3/3 valid (segment stays in rhombus, crosses shared edge interior). Order-3 Euclidean rotation about o--c permutes V1,V2,V3, fixes o,c, restricts to isometry of X permuting strips, so R circ gamma_k=gamma_{k+1}. W2 lift: unique coupling delta_o x delta_c cost 4/3; mu^(k)_t=delta_{gamma_k(t)} satisfies W2(mu_s,mu_t)=d_X(gamma(s),gamma(t))=L0|t-s| (subsegments of minimizer minimizing), constant-speed W2 geodesics, distinct at t=1/2 with separation >=1/3.
